title: Aligning Latent Geometry for Spherical Flow Matching in Image Generation
authors: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Kaan Oktay, Hidir Yesiltepe, Adil Kaan Akan, Pinar Yanardag
description: Projects VAE tokens and Gaussian noise onto a fixed-radius shell and trains flow matching along spherical arcs, which reduces FID by up to 50% on standard tokenizers without modifying the diffusion architecture.

title: VideoMLA: Low-Rank Latent KV Cache for Minute-Scale Autoregressive Video Diffusion
authors: Hidir Yesiltepe, Jiazhen Hu, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Adil Kaan Akan, Kaan Oktay, Hoda Eldardiry, Pinar Yanardag
description: Introduces Multi-Head Latent Attention for autoregressive video diffusion to reduce KV-cache memory by 92.7% through shared low-rank representations on minute-scale long-horizon generation.

title: Infinity-RoPE: Action-Controllable Infinite Video Generation Emerges from Autoregressive Self-Rollout
authors: Hidir Yesiltepe, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Adil Kaan Akan, Kaan Oktay, Pinar Yanardag
description: Infinity-RoPE provides plug-and-play inference strategies for long-horizon video generation with action control and scene transitions.

title: ConceptAttention: Diffusion Transformers Learn Highly Interpretable Features
authors: Alec Helbling, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Ben Hoover, Pinar Yanardag, Duen Horng Chau
description: ConceptAttention reuses DiT attention parameters to produce contextualized concept embeddings and sharper saliency maps without extra training.

title: 2025 SteerCLR: A Contrastive Learning Approach for Unsupervised Discovery of Interpretable Steering Vectors in Large Language Models
authors: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Connor Dunlop, Sanmitra Bhattacharya, Balaji Veeramani, Stephen Adams, Edward Bowen, Pinar Yanardag
description: SteerCLR discovers interpretable steering vectors for controlling implicit LLM behaviors by learning contrastive representations of internal activations.

title: MITHRIL: Playing Tabletop Games with Generative Policies
authors: Michael Atkins, William Denman, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Mustafa Doga Dogan, Pinar Yanardag
description: Workshop paper on generative policies for tabletop gameplay.

title: MotionFlow: Attention-Driven Motion Transfer in Video Diffusion Models
authors: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Hidir Yesiltepe, Connor Dunlop, Pinar Yanardag
description: MotionFlow is a training-free, attention-driven method for motion transfer in video diffusion models.

title: MotionShop: Zero-Shot Motion Transfer in Video Diffusion Models with Mixture of Score Guidance
authors: Hidir Yesiltepe, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Connor Dunlop, Pinar Yanardag
description: MotionShop proposes Mixture of Score Guidance (MSG), a method for motion transfer in video diffusion models.

title: Conditional Information Gain Trellis
authors: Ufuk Can Bicici, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Lale Akarun
description: Conditional Information Gain Trellis (CIGT) learns differentiable routing paths in deep convolutional networks to improve efficiency and interpretability.

title: CLoRA: A Contrastive Approach to Compose Multiple LoRA Models
authors: Tuna Han Salih Meral*, Enis Simsar*, Federico Tombari, Pinar Yanardag
description: CLoRA composes multiple concept and style LoRAs at test time using a contrastive objective. <sup>*</sup> denotes equal contribution.

title: CONFORM: Contrast is All You Need for High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
authors: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Enis Simsar, Federico Tombari, Pinar Yanardag
description: CONFORM improves text-to-image faithfulness with a contrastive objective for stronger object-attribute grounding.

title: 2022 Unsupervised Routing Strategies for Conditional Deep Neural Networks
description: Master's thesis on routing strategies for conditional deep neural networks.

title: 2020 BURST: Software and Simulation Solutions of an Autonomous Vehicle
authors: Fatih Kose, Ibrahim Ozcan, Melih Dal, Metehan Yildirim, Kadir Turksoy, Kerem Zaman, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Sinan Oncu
description: Software and simulation framework contributions for autonomous vehicle development.

title: 2018 Privacy-Preserving Intersection Management for Autonomous Vehicles
venue: International Workshop on Agents in Traffic and Transportation (ATT 2018)
authors: Nadin Kokciyan, Mustafa Erdogan, Tuna Han Salih Meral, Pinar Yolum
description: Approaches for privacy-aware autonomous vehicle coordination at intersections.
